title: AO-MA Native Worker Result Import Report
description: No-secret report artifact produced by the AO-MA-4.6-1 native worker result importer. The operator/AI produces worker_result.v1.json via a native interface (claude-cli, codex-cli, mavis-cli) or a local file; ao-kernel imports + schema-validates + provenance-binds it. ao-kernel does NOT spawn the worker, does NOT call an LLM/API/subprocess, does NOT widen support, and does NOT make a production platform claim. Live LLM worker execution requires a separate operator-bound GPP supersession with live_adapter_execution=true and is out of scope for 4.6-1. Two error classes: fatal trust-boundary errors (artifact schema-invalid, JSON parse fail, manifest sha mismatch, cross-id mismatch) raise NativeWorkerImportError before any report is emitted; reportable policy-invalid (source_interface/provider mismatch, declared/actual mismatch, known_gaps non-empty, existing integrated different hash, runner entry non-eligible) emit a schema-valid import_report with valid=false and no integrated copy.

import_mode.description: Hard-pinned: ao-kernel never spawns the worker, only imports an externally produced worker_result.v1.json.

source_result_path.description: Audit field: where the native AI wrote the worker_result.v1.json. Absolute paths permitted (external native output). Traversal/symlink-escape policy is enforced at runtime against the canonical integrated target, not against this audit field.

source_interface.description: The native interface used by the operator/AI to produce the worker_result.v1.json. Distinct from worker_provider; an operator may use claude-cli to drive an anthropic model.

worker_provider.description: Mirror of worker_result.worker.provider. The (source_interface, worker_provider) pair must be consistent: claude-cli<->anthropic, codex-cli<->openai, mavis-cli<->minimax, local-file<->{local, tool}.

imported_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp. Caller-supplied (the importer module is pure and does not read the wall clock; CLI stamps this from the system clock once and passes it in).

validation_status.description: Top-level outcome. Mirrors valid: when valid=true, status=valid; when valid=false, status=invalid.

valid.description: Recomputed: true iff every entry in checks has outcome=pass. Forged valid=true with any non-pass check is rejected by verify_import_binding.

validation_findings.description: Structured findings. severity=error iff any check outcome=fail; head_sha_not_git_recomputed always emitted as severity=warning for audit transparency (pure-import mode does not call git).

integrated_worker_result_path.description: Absolute path of the atomic copy of worker_result.v1.json under the canonical artifact tree (<artifact_dir>/workers/<task_id>/worker_result.v1.json). Null iff validation_status=invalid (no integrated copy on invalid).

integrated_worker_result_sha256.description: sha256 of the integrated file. Null iff integrated_worker_result_path is null. When non-null, MUST equal source_result_sha256 (machine-recomputed by verify_import_binding).

runner_report_ref.description: {path, sha256, worker_status} of the AO-MA runner_report.v1.json the import bound to. worker_status MUST be 'prepared' or 'skipped_existing_idempotent'.

manifest_ref.description: {path, sha256} of the orchestration manifest.v1.json. sha256 MUST equal runner_report.manifest_sha256 (machine-recomputed).

task_graph_ref.description: {path, sha256} of the bound task_graph.v1.json. sha256 MUST equal the manifest entry's sha256 (machine-recomputed).

assignment_ref.description: {path, sha256} of the bound agent_assignment-*.v1.json. sha256 MUST equal the matched runner_report.workers[] entry's assignment_sha256 AND the manifest entry's sha256.

effective_source_interface_allowlist.description: The source_interface allowlist actually enforced during this import. Audit transparency: an operator-configured narrower allowlist must appear here, not be inferred.

execution_performed_by_ao_kernel.description: Hard-pinned: ao-kernel did NOT spawn the worker. The operator/AI native interface produced the worker_result.v1.json before this import.

ai_output_release_authority.description: Hard-pinned: this import report records evidence; it does NOT release AI output. Release authority remains with the ao-release-gate required check + branch ruleset + non-author approval.

worker_status.description: Only present on runner_report_ref. Other refs MUST NOT carry this field.
